activity.notes: Vasyl Ivanys headed the Kuban government in 1920. The Encyclopedia of Ukraine records his appointment to form a government on 4 January, the retreat from Katerynodar in March, and his continued political leadership during the collapse and exile later that year. Only the documented 1920 territorial-government phase is recorded; no later exile tenure is inferred.
